prompts.display_text: Pin a country where a new temple was dedicated from 2016 through 2018 (not counting rededications).
prompts.text_original: Pin a country where a new temple was dedicated from 2016 through 2018 (not counting rededications).
prompts.summary: From 2016 through 2018, new temples were dedicated in Sapporo, Japan (2016), Paris, France (2017), Concepcion, Chile (2018) and Barranquilla, Colombia (2018), alongside eight in the United States. Paris was the first temple in France.

answers.name: United States of America
answers.fact: Cedar City Utah, 2017; Fort Collins Colorado, 2016; Hartford Connecticut, 2016; and 5 more.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country whose second dedicated temple was dedicated in 2010 or later.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country whose second dedicated temple was dedicated in 2010 or later.
prompts.citation: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org chronology and milestones, read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: A country's second temple, counting only temples now in operation, usually means the Church there has outgrown one temple. New Zealand's second, in Auckland, was dedicated on 13 April 2025, the latest in this set.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country named in the Church's 2022 World Food Programme or 2023 or 2026 UNICEF gifts
prompts.text_original: The Church gave US$32 million to the World Food Programme in September 2022, and US$10 million (August 2023) and US$25 million (May 2026) to UNICEF for mothers and children. A country named as receiving help from one of these three gifts.
prompts.citation: Newsroom 2022 WFP; Church News 2023-08-17; Church News 2026-05-20
prompts.note: Somaliland is scored as part of Somalia.
prompts.summary: In 2022 the Church gave the World Food Programme US$32 million for hunger in nine countries from Afghanistan to Yemen. UNICEF received US$10 million in 2023 for mothers and children in four countries and US$25 million in 2026 for child nutrition in five more.

answers.name: Somalia
answers.fact: WFP 2022 food aid. The gift went to Somalia, which this map splits; a Somaliland pin scores as Somalia.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Pacific island country or territory (not Australia, NZ or Hawaii) with at least one stake as of October 2026.
prompts.text_original: A Pacific island country or territory (not Australia or New Zealand; Hawaii counts as USA) where the Church has at least one stake as of October 2026.
prompts.citation: Church facts and statistics country pages (figures of 31 Dec 2025), read 4 Nov 2026
prompts.summary: Twelve Pacific island countries and territories have stakes. Tonga (21) and Samoa (20) lead, followed by French Polynesia, Papua New Guinea, American Samoa, Fiji and Kiribati. Vanuatu, the Marshall Islands, Guam, Micronesia and New Caledonia have 1 or 2 stakes each. The Cook Islands and Solomon Islands have districts only.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country where the Bible records a prophet speaking face to face with a king.
prompts.text_original: A present-day country where the Bible records a prophet speaking in person to a king
prompts.citation: Exodus 5:1; Numbers 22-24; 1 Samuel 13:13; 2 Samuel 12; 1 Kings 22:10-17; 2 Kings 20; Jeremiah 38; Daniel 2; 2 Kings 3:8-14
prompts.note: Site is in the West Bank or Gaza; a player may reasonably pin ISR as well.
prompts.summary: Prophets often had to face kings. Moses confronted Pharaoh in Egypt, Daniel interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's dream in Babylon, and Nathan, Isaiah and Jeremiah all spoke hard truths to kings in Jerusalem. Samuel rebuked Saul at Gilgal, Micaiah defied Ahab at Samaria (1 Kings 22), and Balaam blessed Israel in front of Balak on the hills of Moab.

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: Moses and Aaron stood before Pharaoh and said, Let my people go (Exodus 5:1).

answers.name: Iraq
answers.fact: Daniel told Nebuchadnezzar his dream and its meaning at Babylon (Daniel 2).

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Nathan rebuked David, Isaiah healed Hezekiah, and Jeremiah warned Zedekiah, all in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 12; 2 Kings 20; Jeremiah 38).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: Samuel rebuked Saul at Gilgal, and Micaiah told Ahab the truth at the gate of Samaria (1 Samuel 13:13; 1 Kings 22:10-17).

answers.name: Jordan
answers.fact: Balaam blessed Israel to the face of Balak king of Moab on the heights above the Jordan (Numbers 22-24). Elisha also spoke with Jehoshaphat and Jehoram in the wilderness of Edom (2 Kings 3:8-14).
